pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, dark brown polygonal patches with high-contrast, jagged edge gradients. Geometry transitions from expansive, high-area shapes on the upper flank to smaller, more fragmented clusters on the ventral and lower hindquarter regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of cream-colored negative-space pathways. Topological nodes are primarily trifurcate. Pixel thickness of pathways is relatively uniform on the mid-flank but exhibits narrowing and increased density toward the lower limbs.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, dense, dark-pigmented mane providing a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette against the background from the mid-neck to the shoulder.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of several dark, localized avian silhouettes (oxpeckers) clinging to the upper neck, mid-dorsal ridge, and lower rump.
